exposure: Gestational age estimation method (last menstrual period vs other methods)
date of the last menstrual period (LMP)
cohort: Live births in Sao Paulo, Brazil between 2012 and 2019.
finding: Gestational age estimated by last menstrual period was associated with a higher prematurity rate compared to other methods, suggesting potential overestimation.
birth_weight: Median birth weight was higher among preterm infants with GA estimated by LMP
